subject: Business Models
title: Multi-Sided Platforms
description: A quick, practical guide to Multi-Sided Platforms.

hook.text: Facebook serves users, advertisers, app developers, and publishers. That's four sides, not two.

buildup.text: Each additional side creates new value exchanges. More sides mean more revenue streams.

discovery.text: Amazon serves buyers, sellers, advertisers, AWS developers, and delivery partners. Five sides, one platform.

twist.text: Managing multiple sides creates conflicts. Amazon both hosts sellers and competes with them.

climax.text: Multi-sided platforms are harder to build but create deeper moats once established.

punchline.text: More sides, more moats, more conflicts. Complexity pays.

quiz.question: What challenge do multi-sided platforms face?
